verdict.rationale: Aider is a local CLI that lets users pick their own LLM backend, including fully local models via Ollama, which indirectly lets a user keep all data on their own machine and avoid any specific cloud region — a de facto residency control. However, there is no explicit region/data-residency configuration, no enterprise data-storage guarantees, and no documentation addressing where LLM API providers store data. Missing for 10: explicit region-selection settings, documented data-residency/compliance guarantees, and enterprise controls over third-party API data handling.
